reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her DM: she should keep Tuesday 10 November at 10:30 free for the Petrel call.

- **Where the time comes from:** on 14 October she asked me to remember that her standing call with Tansleigh Packaging about the Petrel rollout is every Tuesday at 10:30. Her calendar has nothing for 9–13 November, so I told her the date is worked out from that standing time, not from an invite.
- **Name mix-up:** I named Tansleigh Packaging in full so she doesn't confuse it with Tansley Parcel.
- **Heads-up:** I also mentioned her Tansley Parcel call about the Quillon rollout is the same Tuesday at 14:45.

I didn't add anything to her calendar.
